# =============================================================================
# Supply-chain network design (fixed-charge directed network flow)
# =============================================================================
# Decision variables
#   x[i,j] in [0, capacity[i,j]]  NonNegativeReals : units shipped on arc (i,j)
#   y[i,j] in {0,1}               Binary           : 1 if arc (i,j) is established
#
# Objective (minimise)
#   sum_{(i,j)} fixed_cost[i,j] * y[i,j]  +  sum_{(i,j)} var_cost[i,j] * x[i,j]
#
# Constraints
#   1) Capacity linking (source: "total flow does not exceed the connection's
#      capacity" / "establishing a connection incurs a fixed cost"):
#         x[i,j] <= capacity[i,j] * y[i,j]      for all arcs (i,j)
#   2) Flow balance (source: "total incoming goods minus total outgoing goods
#      must equal the facility's net demand"):
#         sum_{j} x[j,i] - sum_{j} x[i,j] == net_demand[i]   for all nodes i
# =============================================================================

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "nodes": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
    "net_demand": {
        0: 106, 1: 144, 2: 0, 3: 0, 4: 202, 5: 40, 6: 8,
    },
    "fixed_cost": {
        (0, 1): 1985, (0, 2): 1968, (0, 3): 2043, (0, 4): 2035, (0, 5): 2043, (0, 6): 1987,
        (1, 0): 2035, (1, 2): 2044, (1, 3): 1985, (1, 4): 2047, (1, 5): 2003, (1, 6): 2005,
        (2, 0): 2000, (2, 1): 1991, (2, 3): 2005, (2, 4): 1969, (2, 5): 2010, (2, 6): 1965,
        (3, 0): 1962, (3, 1): 2024, (3, 2): 2025, (3, 4): 2043, (3, 5): 2034, (3, 6): 2017,
        (4, 0): 1974, (4, 1): 2012, (4, 2): 2009, (4, 3): 1993, (4, 5): 1991, (4, 6): 2040,
        (5, 0): 2044, (5, 1): 2022, (5, 2): 2025, (5, 3): 1955, (5, 4): 2001, (5, 6): 2029,
        (6, 0): 1968, (6, 1): 1956, (6, 2): 1986, (6, 3): 2030, (6, 4): 2001, (6, 5): 1961,
    },
    "var_cost": {
        (0, 1): 19, (0, 2): 19, (0, 3): 19, (0, 4): 19, (0, 5): 21, (0, 6): 21,
        (1, 0): 21, (1, 2): 19, (1, 3): 20, (1, 4): 20, (1, 5): 21, (1, 6): 21,
        (2, 0): 21, (2, 1): 19, (2, 3): 21, (2, 4): 21, (2, 5): 21, (2, 6): 20,
        (3, 0): 21, (3, 1): 19, (3, 2): 21, (3, 4): 19, (3, 5): 19, (3, 6): 20,
        (4, 0): 21, (4, 1): 21, (4, 2): 21, (4, 3): 20, (4, 5): 20, (4, 6): 19,
        (5, 0): 21, (5, 1): 19, (5, 2): 20, (5, 3): 20, (5, 4): 20, (5, 6): 21,
        (6, 0): 19, (6, 1): 21, (6, 2): 19, (6, 3): 20, (6, 4): 21, (6, 5): 21,
    },
    "capacity": {
        (0, 1): 153, (0, 2): 202, (0, 3): 185, (0, 4): 134, (0, 5): 248, (0, 6): 170,
        (1, 0): 214, (1, 2): 184, (1, 3): 193, (1, 4): 181, (1, 5): 153, (1, 6): 139,
        (2, 0): 217, (2, 1): 238, (2, 3): 231, (2, 4): 130, (2, 5): 203, (2, 6): 232,
        (3, 0): 147, (3, 1): 222, (3, 2): 129, (3, 4): 206, (3, 5): 202, (3, 6): 134,
        (4, 0): 183, (4, 1): 210, (4, 2): 238, (4, 3): 193, (4, 5): 157, (4, 6): 137,
        (5, 0): 134, (5, 1): 128, (5, 2): 241, (5, 3): 143, (5, 4): 198, (5, 6): 213,
        (6, 0): 213, (6, 1): 206, (6, 2): 184, (6, 3): 231, (6, 4): 207, (6, 5): 165,
    },
}

GOLD_ANSWER = None


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    nodes = d["nodes"]
    arcs = [(i, j) for i in nodes for j in nodes if i != j]

    out_arcs = {i: [a for a in arcs if a[0] == i] for i in nodes}
    in_arcs = {i: [a for a in arcs if a[1] == i] for i in nodes}

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=nodes)
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=arcs, dimen=2)

    def flow_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0, d["capacity"][(i, j)])

    model.x = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=flow_bounds)
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.Binary)

    # (1) Capacity linking
    def link_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.x[i, j] <= d["capacity"][(i, j)] * m.y[i, j]

    model.link = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=link_rule)

    # (2) Flow balance: incoming - outgoing == net demand
    def balance_rule(m, i):
        incoming = sum(m.x[a] for a in in_arcs[i])
        outgoing = sum(m.x[a] for a in out_arcs[i])
        return incoming - outgoing == d["net_demand"][i]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=balance_rule)

    # Objective: fixed + variable transport cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        fixed = sum(d["fixed_cost"][a] * m.y[a] for a in arcs)
        var = sum(d["var_cost"][a] * m.x[a] for a in arcs)
        return fixed + var

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    return model
